newsitem.title: USA: Avic to invest in Chinese telecom projects.
newsitem.headline: Avic to invest in Chinese telecom projects.

text.p: Avic Group International Inc. said Tuesday it has formed a joint venture with the Hebei Provincial Government in China to develop telecommunications and other related projects in Hebei Province.
The projects require an investment of about $105 million over the next three years, it said.

The partnership expands the relationship of Avic and the Hebei government substantially beyond their contract to build a 70,000 subscriber digital cellular phone network that began operations last month, at a cost of $60 million, Avic said.
The partnership will oversee the development of a 5 million subscriber multimedia hybrid fiber-optical coaxial network, at a cost of $45 million, Avic said.
The partners also previously signed an agreement to develop a fixed wireline network in Hebei.

Avic's first project in Hebei, a digital cellular phone network with Nippon Telegraph & Telephone International as a partner, began commercial operations last month, one year after construction began.
Avic develops telecommunications and information system networks in China, concentrating on the northern province of Hebei and the adjacent cities of Beijing and Tianjin.
Avic stock rose 12.5 cents to $5.125 on the American Stock Exchange at mid-afternoon.
